text: OK so I was not expecting to feel FEELINGS about a woman annotating a poem about a lake but here we are. The cat named Ptolemy. The one-signature petition. Writing letters to a dead poet and the cat sits on the outgoing mail. I was laughing and then I was like wait, is this sad? It's both? The part about the heating clicking off at midnight and nothing between her and the dark but the cat rearranging himself genuinely got me. Also 'speculative cartography' as an academic discipline is the funniest fake thing I've read this year.
